verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Relay serves an llms.txt at support.relayfi.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is a properly formatted file with a product summary, so a user can point an agent at Relay's support docs. Missing for 10: evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt content is, any llms-full.txt or further agent-oriented documentation, and first-party or independent documentation of this capability.
